cues.en: We need to do something about this situation and the approach that you need to take when you face categorical variables in regression models is you need to create dummy variables.
cues.zh: 必須做些處理；在迴歸模型遇到類別變數時，要建立虛擬變數。

cues.en: Let's see how we we can do that.
cues.zh: 看看怎麼做。

cues.en: First you need to go through your column and find all the different categories you have.
cues.zh: 先檢查欄位，找出全部不同類別。

cues.zh: 這裡有兩類。

cues.zh: State 是 California，就在 California 欄填 1；其他類別填 0。

cues.en: And so you end up with a data set like this and these two new columns are called dummy variables and building your regression model from here is very simple.
cues.zh: 最後就得到這份資料集，兩個新欄位叫虛擬變數，接著建立迴歸模型就很簡單。

cues.zh: 只用 New York 欄就足夠，因為值為 1，就知道公司在紐約營運。

cues.zh: 因此，只保留 New York 欄不會遺失資訊。

cues.en: And we will actually talk more about why you should never include all of your dummy variable columns in your regression model.
cues.zh: 下一堂會進一步說明，為什麼模型不應同時加入所有虛擬變數欄位。

cues.en: But for now I would like to discuss two things so first of all the New York column or all of the dummy variables they work as switches.
cues.zh: 但現在先談兩件事。第一，New York 欄，以及其他虛擬變數，都像開關。

cues.en: In this case let's look at the New York column which we're including in our regression.
cues.zh: 看看這個加入迴歸式的 New York 欄。

cues.en: It works like a light switch so if it's a one then you know that this company is in New York.
cues.zh: 它像電燈開關，1 代表公司在紐約。
